text: Students are allowed to graduate after successfully completing the requirements stipulated in the curriculum,and the score forChinese Language Proficiency TestⅣ(HSK4) isno less than180. Theuniversity shall issue a certificate of graduation. The examination of the graduation qualification shall be based onthestudent’s curriculum after enrolment.Students who are qualified to graduate and meet the following conditionshall be granted a Bachelor'sDegree: if GPA is higher than 1.80.
